title: The Rhyming Curse Hypnosis
description:
In this file of hypnotic silliness, I’ll have you rhyming after it. Just listen for the shortest time, and once you’re done you’ll speak in rhyme. A temporary curse, you’ll see, it might be stupid but it’s free. Enjoy the words I speak in verse, imagine I could make it worse. Curse your mind with awful things, not this gentle little fling.

So listen now, and listen good. There is a little likelihood. That into trance you’ll drop quite fast, and normal speech is in the past. For one hour you’re hypnotized, to speak in verse in words and typed. I know you’ll hate it, but I bet, you won’t be able to resist.

CW: You’ll speak and type in rhyme for one hour after listening.
author: Mistress Calia
